description: Evaluator-private deterministic commands for rebuilding the runtime target in gt-memory-env. These commands build artifacts only; PoC execution is described by runtime_spec.json.

commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
export SRC=/gt/_work OUT=/gt/_out WORK=/gt/_work
export CC=clang CXX=clang++
export CFLAGS='-O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=memory -fsanitize-memory-track-origins=2'
export CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS"
export LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE='-fsanitize=fuzzer'
export SANITIZER=memory FUZZING_ENGINE=libfuzzer
rm -rf "$OUT" && mkdir -p "$OUT"
git submodule update --init --recursive
source /gt/oss_fuzz_setup.sh
cd /gt/_work/mupdf
if [ -f ./thirdparty/harfbuzz/src/hb-subset-cff1.cc ]; then sed -i 's/supp_size;/supp_size;(void)(supp_size);/g' ./thirdparty/harfbuzz/src/hb-subset-cff1.cc; fi
LDFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS" make -j"$(nproc)" HAVE_GLUT=no build=debug OUT=$WORK XCFLAGS="$CFLAGS" XCXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS"
clang++ $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -Iinclude /gt/_work/pdf_fuzzer.cc -o $OUT/pdf_fuzzer $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE $WORK/libmupdf.a $WORK/libmupdf-third.a
mv $SRC/{*.zip,*.dict,*.options} $OUT
